uncited: 1. `RotationAndBaseCase` struct: Contains `int Rot` (rotation index) and `int BaseCase` (base case index).
Maps each of the 256 input configurations to its corresponding base case and rotation.
Stores 24 rotation transformations (symmetries of the cube).
Each rotation is represented as a permutation of the 8 vertex indices.
Defines the 23 unique base cases, including their edge intersections and triangle lists.
Each triangle is a triplet of edge indices $(0 \le k \le 11)$.
Given a cube configuration index $C$, retrieve the entry from `MapToBase[C]`.
Extract the base case index $B = \text{MapToBase}[C].\text{BaseCase}$ and the rotation index $R = \text{MapToBase}[C].\text{Rot}$.
Retrieve the triangle list for base case $B$ from `BaseConfig[B]`.
Apply the rotation permutation $P_R$ to the edge indices in the base case's triangle list to generate the final triangles for configuration $C$.
- The rotation transformations must be consistent with the vertex ordering of the voxel.
